text: Before I update the account sheet: What is the site for the store whose appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift at Marrow Agrisupply? Thanks.
reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store is **Pine Crossing**, at Marrow Agrisupply.

That comes from her own message in #central-team on 9 June 2026. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, so a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support try to reproduce it with the store login. Nothing later in that channel says it was fixed, so I suggested she check the status before updating the sheet.

I only used sources Pree can see herself: #central-team, #central-random, #inc-tansley-carrier-api and the public Central team files. I didn't use `search_messages`.

The gbrain lookup didn't work. It refused the search because this connection isn't tied to a member, so nothing was read from it. To fix that, whoever runs the gbrain server needs to bind the connection to the right person with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`. A shared bot like this one can instead be set up to act for a list of members (`--may-act-for`).
